rubrics.justification: It correctly notes no image was provided, but it incorrectly dismisses the supplied Gardner 2AB morphology due to the Day 4 discrepancy and therefore fails to analyze the stated blastocyst features (full blastocyst, strong ICM, loose/few-cell TE).
It integrates age, BMI, AMH/FSH, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness well with prognosis, though some links are somewhat speculative.

The structure is logical overall, but there is a notable inconsistency in rejecting the provided morphology while still building prognosis around inferred embryo stage; some probability adjustments are heuristic rather than clearly evidence-based.

Much of the advice is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommending aggressive luteal support/estrogen and suggesting PGT-A after a single miscarriage in a 30-year-old are not strongly guideline-driven; the handling of the Day 4 vs Gardner discrepancy is also imperfect.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, including luteal support review, alcohol cessation, beta-hCG timing, blastocyst culture, and uterine evaluation, though some recommendations are somewhat generic or overextended.
